messages:
sara: Quick — propose a focused 3-hour copy workshop next Wed to finalize Hosted / Dedicated / Private page copy, launch post angles, webinar landing, and inbound routing. outcome: hero + 3 bullets + CTA for each mode and routing rules.

leo: sounds good. can we fold webinar landing and form routing into that slot? reduces handoffs. :thumbsup:

anya: yes. i'll bring benchmark snippets (latency, cost, reliability) and 2 customer quotes.

matt: i'll draft the HubSpot field list + routing rules. need a pre-qual dropdown for expected requests/min.

julia: timeboxes: 30m hero, 45m body/proof, 30m webinar CTA + assets, 30m inbound routing + UTMs, 15m next steps.

sara: propose 10:000:00 PT? (typo: meant 10:003:00 PT). who can't make 103?

leo: earlier was tough but 103 works.

anya: good for me.

julia: yep.

matt: ok.

content-bot: Reminder: attach pre-read 24h before meeting. template: `./copy/briefs/site-copy-brief.md`

anya: pre-read will include: hero matrix, short benchmark one-pager, competitor lines, 3 customer quotes.

sara: hero axes: predictable latency, cost transparency, deployment flexibility. need short benefit headlines per mode.

leo: first drafts:
- Hosted: "Start in minutes 00ms median latency for common prompts"
- Dedicated: "Reserved capacity, SLA-backed throughput"
- Private: "Run inference on your network with enterprise controls"

julia: tweak Hosted for PLG: "Start in minutes 00ms+ performance, no infra". Dedicated emphasize economics: "Predictable throughput, lower unit cost at scale"

matt: inbound routing rule sketch: collect Use Case + Team Size + Compliance checkbox. if team_size>50 OR compliance=true -> enterprise-sales; else if use_case=evaluation -> webinar nurture; else demo_request -> AE queue. add UTM params: utm_source=launch, utm_campaign=tri-mode-site. add 48h auto-nudge if no response.

anya: add expected RPS dropdown ranges for pre-qual. also capture model preference if listed.

sara: agreed. matt please map HubSpot workflow and demo confirmation tracking.

matt: will add `window.dataLayer.push({event: 'demo_submitted', utm_campaign: 'tri-mode-site'})` to confirmation. also draft workflows.

leo: webinar: 3040m + 15m Q&A. narrative: 1 slide latency, 1 slide cost with batching, 1 slide fallback/routing. two angles: benchmark-first (tech audience) and customer-first (product channels).

anya: i'll run a quick benchmark and attach charts. want to show batching impact on cost and latency distribution.

julia: owners: hero headlines (leo), body/value props + proof (anya), webinar slides (anya+leo), form fields + routing (matt), AB test variants + launch copy (sara). i'll facilitate.

sara: action items due Tue 5pm PT for pre-read. we'll finalize copy in workshop and have final drafts by Fri. thanks team! :clap:
